description: Eight rows of pitch detuning, each with a sine LFO of its own, feeding a mono output per row and one shared polyphonic output

params.text: Sets how far this row detunes the pitch, 0 to 50 cents either side
Turns this row's output into two channels, one detuned up and one detuned down by the same amount
Sets the rate of this row's sine LFO, 0 to 4Hz; at 0 the LFO stops and the row detunes by a fixed amount
Sends this row to the poly output as well as to its own jack

inputs.text: The 1V/octave pitch for this row; with nothing patched the row takes the pitch of the nearest row above it that has a cable
Scales this row's detuning, 0-10V for none to the full amount set by its cents knob; with nothing patched the full amount is used

outputs.text: The detuned pitch for this row, as one channel or as two when mirror is on
The rows whose to-poly button is on, one channel each and two for a row with mirror on

notes: a row is only calculated while its own output is patched, or while its to-poly button is on and the poly output is patched.
